verdict.rationale: The marketing line 'Put code review, QA, and documentation on autopilot across your repos' (factory-docs-14) is the only hint that Factory touches repo documentation, but there is no evidence of a feature that generates queryable documentation for any repo (public or private) or a way to search/query such docs. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation-generation feature, evidence of querying/searching generated docs, and support for both public and private repos explicitly.
